prompt: Arrange the phases of a Sentinel-managed failover in order.
explanation: One Sentinel stops receiving replies within down-after-milliseconds and marks the master subjectively down; when enough Sentinels agree (the quorum), the master is objectively down; the Sentinels then elect a leader among themselves via majority agreement; the leader selects the most up-to-date replica and promotes it; finally clients discover the new master by querying Sentinel.

options.text: A Sentinel marks the master down after missing replies for down-after-milliseconds
Enough Sentinels agree, making the failure objective at the configured quorum
The Sentinels elect a leader among themselves by majority
The elected leader promotes the most up-to-date replica to master
Clients requery Sentinel and reconnect to the new master
